continuity: Hong Jin knows the coachman is connected to the Lower District Sect’s Shanxi branch and asks him to report the situation and find Jin Taekyung.
Hong Jin identifies Jin Taekyung as the most trustworthy person in Murim to protect Prince Shangshan.
An imperial party presents a decree and takes Hong Jin; Prince Shangshan is unharmed at that moment, and Hong Jin heads toward him.
Taiyuan’s Jin Family has become a dominant power in the city; local residents voice concern about ominous Murim rumors and activity in the northern plateau.
plot: As Hong Jin rides through Taiyuan, he reflects on his impoverished past and the Jin Family’s rise. He tells his coachman to alert the Lower District Sect’s Shanxi branch and use its information network to find Jin Taekyung, whom he trusts to protect Prince Shangshan. An imperial party arrives to take Hong Jin away; the prince is unharmed for now, and Hong Jin goes to him.

active_continuity: The Divine Physician secured the Blood Soul Gu found in the deceased City Lord of Sichuan Province; it weakens hosts, causes episodes of madness, and eventually kills them.
Namho links Blood Soul Gu to the Five Poisons Sect’s ancient war with the Nanman Beast Palace; Jin believes Dark Heaven brought it from Nanman to the Central Plains.
Jin suspects Dark Heaven’s covert killing of the City Lord is part of a scheme targeting the Great Nation, possibly its imperial family.
Jin considers Prince Shangshan Zhu Bao a key to the suspected scheme; the token Zhu Bao gave him seems to tremble inside the Inventory.
Hong Jin asked the Lower District Sect’s Shanxi branch to find Jin Taekyung, whom he trusts to protect Prince Shangshan.
An imperial party took Hong Jin under an imperial decree; Prince Shangshan was unharmed at that moment.
open_questions: Why did Dark Heaven secretly kill the City Lord of Sichuan Province?
Is Dark Heaven targeting the Great Nation’s Emperor or imperial family, and what is its intended scheme?
How is Prince Shangshan Zhu Bao connected to the suspected scheme?
What prompted the imperial decree against Hong Jin, and what will happen to him and Prince Shangshan?

profile_updates.current: - **Personality:** Composed, observant, and socially deft, candid about his fondness for bribes, and unwaveringly loyal to Prince Shangshan; he remains unashamed and matter-of-fact about having been castrated.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Personality:** Composed and socially deft, Hong Jin is considerate toward those beneath him and dislikes excessive deference, which recalls his impoverished past.

profile_updates.current: - **Relationships:** The late Emperor ordered him to assist Prince Shangshan; Hong Jin has served the prince since infancy and remains loyal to him, while recognizing Taekyung as a young hero of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, increasingly enjoying his company and ruthless political methods, and forming an immediate joking rapport with Jin Wikyung.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Relationships:** Hong Jin has served Prince Shangshan since infancy and is devoted to protecting him; he trusts Jin Taekyung as the person best able to keep the prince safe.
